description:
Compare available phone numbers and their prices without buying or charging.

        Returns ``offers``, ``recommended_quote_id`` and ``expires_at``.
        Each offer includes ``e164``, ``number_type``, ``capabilities``, ``quote_id``,
        ``monthly_cents``, ``setup_cents``, ``readiness``, ``requirements``,
        ``subject_types``, ``verifications``, ``locality`` and ``region``.
        Prices are USD cents. ``locality`` and ``region`` tell apart cities with the same name.
        Quotes expire after ten minutes. Expired quotes cannot authorize a purchase.
        ``recommended_quote_id`` identifies a ready offer or is null when none is ready.

        ``subject_types`` identifies eligible personal or business registrations.
        ``verifications`` contains accepted registrations, with approved entries first.
        Entries include ``id``, ``state``, ``subject_type`` and ``subject_name``.
        ``readiness="verification_required"`` means registration approval is still needed.
        Registration requirements are specific to the quote and applicant type.
        An offer with ``by_request=true`` has no assigned number and requires a manual support order.
        Such offers remain valid for registration but are unavailable for automatic purchase.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

area_code.description: First digits of the number as dialed inside the country, such as ``415``. Omitted: any digits.
area_code.title: Area Code

capabilities.description: Channels each offer must support. Omitting the filter searches for numbers that support both calls and texts.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

city.description: City name as carriers list it, such as ``Austin``. Omitted: any city.
city.title: City

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_type.description: Offer only this kind of number, for example ``toll_free`` for a number callers reach for free. Omitted: every kind.
number_type.title: Number Type

region.description: US state or Canadian province code from ``list_number_regions``, to tell apart cities with the same name. Omitted: any region.
region.title: Region

name: quote_numbers

held_cents.description: Credit, in USD cents, set aside from your balance for this verification: setup and the first month of the offer it was started for. A purchase with this verification counts it toward the price. 0 when nothing is set aside.
held_cents.title: Held Cents

id.description: Hail verification id. Read it with GET /v1/verifications/{verification_id}.
id.title: Id

state.description: State of that verification, such as draft, submitted or approved.
state.title: State

subject_name.description: Name of the person or company that verification is for, as typed in the verification form. Null when unknown.
subject_name.title: Subject Name

subject_type.description: Who that verification is for: 'person' (you) or 'business' (your company).
subject_type.title: Subject Type

QuoteOffer.description:
One number offer as the public API shows it. It never names the
carrier or carries a carrier-issued id: Hail picks the carrier.

by_request.description: True when support orders this number by hand: it cannot be bought with POST /numbers. Ask support for it. Its quote_id still works for verification.
by_request.title: By Request

capabilities.description: Voice/SMS capabilities reported by live carrier inventory; SMS registration may still be required.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country code of the number.
country_code.title: Country Code

currency.description: Currency of the quoted rental and setup amounts.
currency.title: Currency

e164.description: Available phone number in E.164 format. Null for a by-request offer: support picks the number when it orders it.
e164.title: E164

locality.description: City or area the carrier lists for this number, such as Phoenix or London; null when unknown.
locality.title: Locality

monthly_cents.description: Monthly number rental in USD cents, charged from organization credits.
monthly_cents.title: Monthly Cents

number_type.description: Local, mobile, national, or toll-free number type.
number_type.title: Number Type

paperwork.description: Always null for this tool. Applicant-specific paperwork is available from get_verification_requirements for the chosen offer.

quote_id.description: Organization-bound quote identifier to pass to POST /numbers before expiry.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

readiness.description: Whether regulatory preflight permits purchase for this organization; rechecked at purchase.
readiness.title: Readiness

region.description: State, province or region the carrier lists, such as AZ or England; null when unknown.
region.title: Region

regulatory_friction.description: Remaining verification effort derived from live requirements: none, information/address entry, document uploads, or unknown. This does not establish legal eligibility.
regulatory_friction.title: Regulatory Friction

requirements.description: Carrier regulatory requirement labels associated with this offer.
requirements.title: Requirements

setup_cents.description: One-time setup charge in USD cents, payable with the first month.
setup_cents.title: Setup Cents

subject_types.description: Who can verify for this number: 'person' (you), 'business' (your company), or both. Empty when no verification is needed.
subject_types.title: Subject Types

verification.description: Deprecated: read `verifications`. The verification a purchase without verification_id would use: the one approved verification in `verifications`, else the newest one there; null when there is none.

verifications.description: The verifications you can buy this offer with, approved first, then newest first: yours of a subject type in `subject_types` that are under review, and the approved ones the carrier still accepts for this offer. Once one is approved, pass its `id` as `verification_id` to POST /numbers to buy with it.
verifications.title: Verifications

QuoteOffer.title: QuoteOffer

expires_at.description: UTC expiry of these persisted quotes; request fresh offers afterward.
expires_at.title: Expires At

incomplete.description: True when some carriers did not answer, so the offers may not be complete. Search again later for a full comparison.
incomplete.title: Incomplete

offers.description: Live offers ordered by readiness, remaining verification effort, monthly price and setup price.
offers.title: Offers

recommended_quote_id.description: Recommended ready offer, or null if none qualifies.
recommended_quote_id.title: Recommended Quote Id

title: Quote phone numbers
